settings.hero_body: A clean editorial storefront inspired by the supplied design reference, rebuilt for Shopify with bold hierarchy, calmer surfaces, and stronger product storytelling.
settings.hero_media_heading: Layered visuals, premium rhythm, and a homepage that feels designed instead of templated.
settings.hero_note_text: White space, black typography, warm neutrals, and a restrained red accent guide the whole page.
settings.hero_note_text_two: Collections, products, images, and copy all stay editable after launch.
settings.categories_copy: The card row mirrors the PDF structure while staying flexible enough for your real collections and product imagery.
settings.gallery_copy: This section recreates the mixed image rhythm from the reference and works well for campaign images, room shots, or best-selling products.
settings.manifesto_body: Use the dark campaign block for a new collection, a hero story, or a focused callout around your strongest category. It keeps the same premium contrast that stood out in the design PDF.
settings.products_copy: Once you assign a featured collection, this strip automatically fills with real products from the store.
settings.values_copy: Short trust points keep the page feeling polished without interrupting the editorial flow.
settings.story_body: The layout is intentionally image-led and modular, so it can support stickers, wall graphics, framed art, or any other design-led product line without feeling boxed into a generic theme.
settings.utility_copy: These supporting tiles can point to room edits, product bundles, collection pages, or service information.
settings.closing_line: Minimal form. Strong feeling. Designed for scrolling and shopping.

settings.heading: New in
settings.subtext: Fresh pieces and new arrivals arranged with the same editorial tone as the reference.

settings.heading: Best sellers
settings.subtext: A focused route into the products you want customers to see first.

settings.heading: Graphic walls
settings.subtext: Use this slot for statement products, room-defining details, or your most visual category.

settings.heading: Room accents
settings.subtext: Secondary products, smaller add-ons, or accessories that round out the homepage.

settings.heading: Design-led layout
settings.text: The homepage leans on editorial spacing and stronger hierarchy so it feels branded from the first scroll.

settings.heading: Collection-driven
settings.text: Real store products can power the imagery and featured products, which keeps the design flexible as the catalog grows.

settings.heading: Easy to manage
settings.text: Images, headings, collection links, and campaign tiles can all be updated inside the Shopify Theme Editor.

settings.heading: Shop the room
settings.text: Point customers toward a styled collection, a room-based edit, or your hero product family.

settings.heading: Build a gallery wall
settings.text: Use this tile for bundles, curated sets, or a guide that helps shoppers visualize the products.

settings.heading: Need help choosing?
settings.text: A third tile is useful for FAQs, material details, shipping information, or personalized recommendations.
